infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_sandbagsmaterial: A material capable of absorbing and dispersing impact forces is used to construct sandbag bunker to block bullets and withstand the shock waves and debris generated by explosions. In addition, it can also serve as a support point for firearms (Increasing ‖color:gui.orange‖Spread Reduction‖color:end‖ when the bunker structure is relatively intact). When setup the bunker, the materials must be intact. It can be recycled when deconstructing the bunker.
